value: **Involvement**: Teachers partnered with researchers in an iterative collaborative design process to conceptualize, author, and contextualize curricular materials and learning activities tailored to their classroom environments. **Evidence**: "The activities were designed and ref ined with inputs from teachers (in a participatory design model) and middle-school students (through 2 rounds of piloting involving “thinkalouds”)."
